messages:
rachel: opened a small PR to align Ruby SDK retry/backoff semantics with the JS client. Noticing a few community issues about surprising 429 behavior. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1401

ben: can you summarize the behavior change? is this opt-in or preserving backward compatibility?

rachel: goal is parity: exponential backoff with jitter + idempotent-safe fast retry. Default preserved for existing users but new config option `retry_policy: :parity` enables exact JS semantics. Tests added for 429/5xx/timeout cases.

ci-bot: pipeline: ruby-ci matrix started. jobs: ruby-3.1, ruby-2.7, windows-ruby-3.2. Logs: https://ci.internal/builds/9244

tomo: quick nit on PR: can we add a one-line note in CHANGELOG and sampleapp README about the new `retry_policy` option? community folks asked how to opt in. Also consider a migration note in upgrade guide.

rachel: good call. I'll add changelog entry and README snippet showing how to set `client = Redwood::Client.new(retry_policy: :parity)` and a suggested default for server-side rate limits.

ben: also add a tiny unit test demonstrating that idempotent POSTs are retried and non-idempotent ones are not. makes it clearer.

rachel: added tests and pushed. pinging @ben for review once CI is green.

ci-bot: windows job failed with a flake in sampleapp start: `SocketError: getaddrinfo: Name or service not known` (transient). Full logs: https://ci.internal/builds/9244

ben: Windows DNS flake in our CI image again. if it keeps failing, we should gate the integration sampleapp tests behind an env var, or add a retry wrapper to test harness. Not critical to block the retry semantics change.

rachel: will add a tiny harness retry for sampleapp start in tests, and note the gating in CI matrix. will also post a short community note.

community-bot: referenced issue: community/ruby-retry-clarify (https://github.com/redwood-inference/community/issues/104)

tomo: one more thought: link to the JS backoff algorithm in the README so folks can compare param values (base, max, jitter). helps support when people tune for low-latency workloads.

rachel: added link + examples, updated CHANGELOG. pushing final commit.

ci-bot: all matrix jobs green except intermittent windows DNS job retriggered. See build 9248.

ben: thanks for the quick turnaround — will review final PR today. small docs + tests look great. :thumbsup:

rachel: thanks everyone. i'll merge after your sign-off and open a follow-up issue to track the windows CI sampleapp flake so it doesn't block community contributors. :raised_hands:
